macclesfield.snapshot: Macclesfield sits in a busy east Cheshire full-fibre build, and the trade splits two ways. Build contractors and structured-cabling firms field crews of engineers and buy branded kit through trade accounts, while ex-BT sole traders and one-van broadband and CCTV installers order a few pieces direct online with no account. A workwear supplier here has to serve the fleet and the single installer alike, which is why we run both routes side by side.
macclesfield.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of east Cheshire
s1loc: Macclesfield is in the middle of a fast full-fibre rollout. Openreach is pushing FTTP out through the town and the surrounding east Cheshire villages, and the alternative network Netomnia is building alongside it, taking ultrafast fibre into thousands of homes across districts like Hurdsfield, Tytherington, Broken Cross and Weston. Virgin Media and the mobile operators keep upgrading on top, and behind the residential build sits the usual mix of civils crews, fibre jointers and overhead engineers working the streets, cabinets and customer premises day in and day out across the town.

The commercial side is just as active. The Hurdsfield Industrial Estate off Charter Way - home to the long-established AstraZeneca pharmaceutical site - along with the Tytherington Business Park and the offices around Macclesfield town centre keep structured-cabling and CCTV installers busy wiring Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre for businesses, schools and multi-site employers. Local cabling and network firms take on office fit-outs and IP camera work across east Cheshire, so the demand runs from large managed sites down to the small independent installer fitting a handful of points.
